issues.description: The parameter label for Course.addRating differs between artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect an external label 'stars' (addRating(stars:)), but the solution's Course implementation declares the parameter as 'rating' (addRating(rating:)). Additionally, the solution's Client calls use addRating(stars:), which is inconsistent with the solution Course declaration and will cause a compilation/usage mismatch. This discrepancy can confuse students about the correct method signature and may prevent the provided solution from compiling as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the parameter label across all artifacts. Prefer matching the problem/template by changing the solution Course method signature to 'func addRating(stars: Int)' (and update any internal uses accordingly), or alternatively change the problem/template and client calls to use 'rating' consistently. Ensure Client and Course implementations use the same external parameter name so the code compiles and the API is unambiguous for students.
